purpose: Reconstruct the reference site's interaction grammar and visual system for Engineering Intelligence using original Engineering Intelligence content and data.

typography.referenceFamily: Brunswick Grotesque reported by design-index sources
typography.implementation: system grotesk stack to avoid copying proprietary font assets

geometry.composition: full-viewport graph field + compact floating index card

informationArchitecture.secondary: floating INDEX card with accordion sections
informationArchitecture.tertiary: small floating detail card opened from a node or index row

interaction.responsive: mobile uses bottom index sheet while graph remains visible

motion.graph: transform-based pan/zoom with no decorative continuous animation

implementation.rationale: Current dataset is small. A dependency-free SVG/DOM implementation matches the reference more closely and avoids unnecessary graph-library overhead.

consideredRepositories.reason: useful force-layout primitive but unnecessary for a deliberately composed small graph
excellent large-graph renderer, excessive for current node count
strong graph analysis/visualisation, excessive for current visual-only interaction

contentBoundary.reuse: layout grammar, node-map metaphor, compact index interaction, typographic scale, spatial feel
